description: A fine-toothed backsaw used to cut shallow kerfs across the back of a text block so recessed supports can be sunk into it; a quicker method that Cockerell records as weakening the binding.
name: tenon saw

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter VII, p.98. Internet Archive.
